newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Cerebos falls to new low on baht woes.
newsitem.headline: Cerebos falls to new low on baht woes.

text.p: Food group Cerebos Pacific Ltd plunged to a new year low of Singapore $5.70 in early trading on Thursday because of its exposure to Thailand, traders said.
After half an hour of trading, it recovered slightly to S$5.85, down 25 cents. Volume was 157,000 units.
Cerebos, which sells Brand's chicken essence, counts Thailand as one of its key markets in Asia.

The company was quoted as saying its earnings would be affected by the de facto devaluation of the baht as it could incur foreign exchange losses when profit from Thailand is brought back to Singapore.
Managing Director Ken Kobayashi told the Straits Times on Wednesday: "The weakened Thai currency will affect Cerebos' group performance this year."
